errors.evidence: The chart does not show any exploded or displaced sectors. The slice for "Природен газ" (Natural gas) is represented by a leader line pointing to the circumference of the pie, but it is not visually separated from the main circle.
The legend is located at the bottom of the chart area and spans its entire width, not just in the bottom left corner.
